name: export_build_environment
description: Export the stopped capture as an agentenv computer app bundle with the given task, inside the computer, seeded at seed and checked at end, then copy the bundle to a new or empty folder on this host, every file checked against its digest. A task the export refuses, such as a check that already passes on the seed, is an error naming why. Witness the bundle next: start_build_computer from the folder and check_build_task.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

directory.description: A new or empty folder on this host for the bundle.

name.description: The environment's name; derived from the app by default.
